sub_sections.title: Dates
sub_sections.description_text:
I wanted to create a list to remind people to play each game on a certain date to get the date based achievements. This list is in order of which day it falls on. They can be completed in any month.

[list]
[*] 6th  - Halo 4 (A Long Time Ago)
[*] 9th  - Halo 2 (Back At It)
[*] 14th - Halo Reach (Remember Reach)
[*] 15th - Halo CE (A Day To Remember)
[*] 22nd - Halo 3: ODST (Do You Remember When We Met)
[*] 25th - Halo 3 (Third Times The Charm)
[/list]
